---
title: "Lies, big lies, and Russian statistics"
description: "Why Russia's official 1.8% GDP decline for Q1 2023 likely understates the real contraction by masking it in inflated price deflators."
date: "2023-07-07"
categories: [ukraine, russia-economy]
---

A close read of Rosstat's Q1 2023 release, comparing nominal and real
sectoral figures. The implied GDP deflator for raw materials shows a 31.3%
price decline against an officially reported 26.3%, and similar gaps recur
across other sectors — inconsistencies that flatter the real growth number.
Correcting for them points to an actual contraction closer to 5%, far worse
than the headline 1.8%, and a reminder that wartime Russian statistics need
independent scrutiny before they feed into international forecasts.

**Originally published on Substack**, July 7, 2023.
